anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: the night has advanced, the day has drawn near.

pass_a_gloss: And the night is taken upon the present world, and the day upon the coming one, as the same apostle witnesses saying: The night has advanced, and the day has drawn near.
pass_b_english: [And the night] is taken of the present [world], and the [day] of the one to come, as the [same] apostle bears witness, saying: ["The night] has advanced, and the day [has drawn near]."
source_text: [ἡ νὺξ δὲ] ἐπὶ τοῦ ἐνεστῶτος [κόσμο]υ λαμβάνεται, ἡ δὲ ἡ[μέρα ἐ]πὶ μέλλοντος, ὡς ὁ αὐ[τὸς ἀπ]όστολος μαρτυρεῖ λέγων· ["Ἡ νὺξ] προέκοψεν, ἡ δὲ ἡμέρα [ἤγγικε]ν".
